title: EntityResult
description: Array of entities that can be used as filter values in Detection Rule Search.

id.description: Entity ID for use in detection-rule/search filter

DetectionRuleEntity.description: An entity that is associated with a Detection rule, e.g. a MITRE ATT&CK tag or a Malware.

EntityTypeName.description: Additional information about entity types is provided by the /entity/types endpoint. It can be used to find the display name of the entity type.
